verdict.rationale: Slate can spin up subagents that run in the background while you keep working, parallelize many tasks, and sustain multi-hour sessions. Permission prompts can be bypassed with `--yolo`, and a built-in `goal` program exists. All of this happens inside an interactive TUI session, though, not as automations you set up once and leave running. Missing for 10: scheduled or event-triggered automations, a headless/non-interactive mode for unattended runs, persistent automation definitions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
